mutants.name: d1_01_top_grid_point_never_a_successor.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d round 1): the successor loop stops one point early, so the top grid point is never a saving, which is wrong on a grid wholly in (0, 1].

mutants.name: d1_02_continuation_reads_the_current_state.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d round 1): the continuation term is beta times V at the current state k, not at the saving k'.

mutants.name: d1_03_value_is_the_penultimate_iterate.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d round 1): solve returns the vector before the last sweep while certified_error refers to the last sweep.

mutants.name: d2_01_feasibility_is_strict.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d fixer round 1): feasibility is strict, so a saving exactly at the resources k**alpha is refused although it leaves zero consumption.

mutants.name: d2_02_utility_without_square_root.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d fixer round 1): the utility is the consumption itself rather than its square root.

mutants.name: d2_03_first_point_must_be_below_one.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d fixer round 1): a grid whose first point equals 1 is refused, although its resources are 1 and it can save everything.

mutants.name: d2_04_beta_may_equal_one.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d fixer round 1): beta equal to 1 is accepted, although the specification's open interval (0, 1) excludes it.

mutants.name: d2_05_stop_strictly_below_tol.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d fixer round 1): the stop test is strict, so a certified error exactly equal to tol does not stop the iteration.

mutants.name: d2_06_budget_accepts_floats.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d fixer round 1): a float budget such as 2.0 is accepted as a number of sweeps.

mutants.name: d2_07_iteration_starts_from_ones.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d fixer round 1): solve starts the iteration from a vector of ones instead of the zero vector.

mutants.name: d2_08_one_sweep_too_many.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d fixer round 1): the iteration makes one sweep more than max_iter allows.

mutants.name: d2_09_change_at_top_point_only.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d fixer round 1): the change is measured at the top grid point alone rather than as the sup norm over the whole grid.

mutants.name: d2_10_feasibility_uses_capital_not_resources.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d fixer round 1): feasibility tests the saving against the current capital k instead of the resources k**alpha.

mutants.name: d3_01_feasibility_allows_a_tie_tolerance_of_1e-12.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 round 2): feasibility allows a successor up to 1e-12 above k**alpha, a tie tolerance the exact test k' <= k**alpha does not have.

mutants.name: d3_02_first_point_bound_checked_only_for_longer_grids.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 round 2): the first-point-at-most-one check runs only for grids of two or more points, so the one-point grid [1.5] is accepted.

mutants.name: d3_03_value_is_the_penultimate_iterate_when_the_budget_runs_out.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 round 2): when the budget runs out without convergence, value is the vector before the last sweep, while certified_error refers to the last sweep.

mutants.name: m01_continuation_divided_by_beta.py
mutants.description: the continuation value is divided by beta instead of multiplied, which inverts the discount

mutants.name: m02_certificate_without_beta_factor.py
mutants.description: the certified error is the last change without the factor beta over one minus beta, which is unsound for beta above one half

mutants.name: m03_stop_on_change_report_tol.py
mutants.description: stops when the last change is at most tol and reports certified_error equal to tol, whatever the true error

mutants.name: m04_infeasible_successors_clipped_to_zero_utility.py
mutants.description: successors above the resources are allowed, with consumption clipped at zero, so saving more than one has is possible

mutants.name: m05_output_equals_capital.py
mutants.description: resources are the capital itself, so the production exponent alpha is dropped from the model

mutants.name: m06_off_by_one_sweep_budget.py
mutants.description: the sweep loop runs one sweep past max_iter, so iterations can exceed the budget by one

mutants.name: m07_resources_snapped_down_to_grid.py
mutants.description: resources are snapped down to the largest grid point before the feasibility test, which changes the fixed point

mutants.name: m08_max_replaced_by_min.py
mutants.description: the successor choice takes the minimum instead of the maximum

mutants.name: m09_boolean_budget_accepted.py
mutants.description: max_iter accepts a boolean, so True is read as a budget of one sweep

mutants.name: m100_budget_exhaustion_raises.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (verifier-written, M5 slice d round 8): the solver raises instead of returning converged false when max_iter sweeps run out without meeting tol.

mutants.name: m101_certificate_compares_with_two_sweeps_back.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (verifier-written, M5 slice d round 9): the certified change compares the new sweep with the vector two sweeps back, not with the previous sweep.

mutants.name: m102_certified_error_clipped_at_tol.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (verifier-written, M5 slice d round 9): the reported certified error is clipped at the tolerance, so it never exceeds tol.

mutants.name: m103_continuation_reads_the_current_state.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (verifier-written, M5 slice d round 9): every feasible saving is discounted by the value of the current state, not of the saving.

mutants.name: m10_beta_equal_to_one_accepted.py
mutants.description: beta equal to one is accepted, although the operator is then not a contraction

mutants.name: m11_equal_grid_points_accepted.py
mutants.description: a grid with two equal points is accepted, although the grid must be strictly increasing

mutants.name: m12_zero_tolerance_accepted.py
mutants.description: a tolerance of zero is accepted instead of refused

mutants.name: m13_first_grid_point_bound_loosened.py
mutants.description: a first grid point up to 1.5 is accepted, so a state may have no feasible successor

mutants.name: m14_hard_coded_seed_zero_answer.py
mutants.description: returns a stored answer whenever beta, alpha and the grid size match seed 0, whatever tol and max_iter are

mutants.name: m15_feasibility_strict_drops_the_tie_k_prime_equal_resources.py
mutants.description: feasibility uses a strict inequality, so a successor equal to k**alpha (zero consumption) is refused

mutants.name: m16_iteration_starts_from_ones_not_zero.py
mutants.description: the iteration starts from the vector of ones instead of the zero vector V_0 = 0

mutants.name: m17_sweep_budget_ignored.py
mutants.description: the solver ignores max_iter and iterates until the certified error is within tol

mutants.name: m18_converged_strictly_below_tol.py
mutants.description: converged and the stop use a strict inequality, so a certified error exactly equal to tol is not accepted

mutants.name: m19_operator_overwrites_the_callers_values.py

mutants.name: m20_utility_linear_in_consumption.py

mutants.name: m35_iterations_reported_one_fewer_when_converged.py

mutants.name: m36_successor_cannot_exceed_todays_capital.py

mutants.name: m37_strictly_increasing_check_dropped.py

mutants.name: m38_grid_order_checked_only_at_the_ends.py

mutants.name: m39_equal_last_pair_accepted.py

mutants.name: m40_first_point_bound_applied_to_the_last_point.py

mutants.name: m41_string_beta_coerced_to_a_number.py

mutants.name: m42_stop_strictly_below_tol.py
mutants.description: the solver stops only when the certified error is strictly below tol, so a tie does not stop the iteration.

mutants.name: m43_converged_uses_the_change_not_the_certificate.py

mutants.name: m44_negative_tolerance_accepted.py

mutants.name: m45_zero_budget_accepted.py

mutants.name: m46_zero_grid_point_accepted.py
mutants.description: the positivity check tests point < 0, so a grid point equal to zero is accepted.

mutants.name: m47_values_length_checked_only_when_shorter.py
mutants.description: bellman_operator accepts a values list longer than the grid and ignores the extra entries.

mutants.name: m48_continuation_term_dropped_myopic.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (verifier-written, M5 slice d round 3): myopic: the continuation term beta * V(k') is dropped, so each state only sees today's consumption.

mutants.name: m49_utility_of_output_not_consumption.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (verifier-written, M5 slice d round 3): utility is sqrt of the output k**alpha, minus the saving: the consumption is taken as sqrt(k**alpha) - k'.

mutants.name: m50_resources_use_beta_for_the_exponent.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (verifier-written, M5 slice d round 3): the output exponent is beta where the specification says alpha: k**beta is used for the resources.

mutants.name: m51_certificate_missing_the_one_minus_beta_denominator.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (verifier-written, M5 slice d round 3): the certified error is beta times the change, with the geometric-sum denominator (1 - beta) dropped.

mutants.name: m52_beta_zero_accepted.py
mutants.description: beta equal to zero is accepted, so the interval is closed at zero instead of open.

mutants.name: m53_alpha_one_accepted.py
mutants.description: alpha equal to one is accepted, although the page's open interval (0, 1) excludes it.

mutants.name: m54_nan_tolerance_accepted.py
mutants.description: the tolerance is refused when it is at most zero, which a NaN tolerance passes because NaN compares false.

mutants.name: m55_alpha_coerced_by_float.py
mutants.description: alpha is read with float(), so the string '0.5' is accepted as an exponent.

mutants.name: m56_change_measured_as_a_sum.py
mutants.description: the change is the sum of absolute entry differences instead of the largest one.

mutants.name: m57_negative_budget_accepted.py
mutants.description: max_iter is refused only when it is zero, so a negative budget gives zero sweeps.

mutants.name: m58_short_values_truncated_silently.py
mutants.description: a values list shorter than the grid is accepted and the operator returns a shorter vector.

mutants.name: m59_nan_and_boolean_grid_points_accepted.py
mutants.description: grid points are read with float(), so a NaN or a boolean point is accepted.

mutants.name: m60_converged_when_the_budget_runs_out.py
mutants.description: converged is also True when the budget is exhausted, whatever the certified error.

mutants.name: m61_resources_raised_to_one_over_alpha.py
mutants.description: resources are k to the power 1/alpha, so the exponent in the output is inverted.

mutants.name: m62_alpha_zero_accepted.py
mutants.description: alpha equal to zero is accepted, because the lower bound of the interval is not strict.

mutants.name: m63_iteration_starts_from_utility_of_the_grid.py
mutants.description: the iteration starts from the utility sqrt(k) of each grid point instead of from the zero vector.

mutants.name: m64_change_measured_at_the_last_point_only.py
mutants.description: the change is measured at the last grid point only, so the certified error can be too small.

mutants.name: m65_converged_with_ten_times_the_tolerance.py
mutants.description: converged is read against ten times the tolerance, so a run above tol reports converged.

mutants.name: m66_iterations_report_the_budget.py
mutants.description: iterations reports the sweep budget, not the number of sweeps actually made.

mutants.name: m67_negative_grid_point_accepted.py
mutants.description: a negative grid point is accepted, because only a zero point is refused.

mutants.name: m68_certificate_factor_beta_squared.py
mutants.description: the certified factor is beta squared over one minus beta, which understates the error by a factor of beta.

mutants.name: m69_stop_only_when_strictly_below_tol.py
mutants.description: the iteration stops only when the certified error is strictly below tol, so a tie runs one more sweep.

mutants.name: m70_tolerance_above_one_refused.py
mutants.description: a tolerance above one is refused, although the page accepts any finite tol greater than zero.

mutants.name: m71_certificate_lags_one_sweep.py
mutants.description: the certified error reported after a sweep is the factor times the change of the sweep before it.

mutants.name: m72_successor_equal_to_resources_refused.py
mutants.description: a successor exactly equal to k**alpha is treated as infeasible, so the zero-consumption saving is lost.

mutants.name: m73_first_feasible_successor_chosen_not_best.py
mutants.description: the operator takes the first feasible successor instead of the maximum over the feasible set.

mutants.name: m74_iteration_starts_from_ones.py
mutants.description: solve starts the iteration from the vector of ones rather than from the zero vector.

mutants.name: m75_converged_true_when_budget_runs_out.py
mutants.description: converged is reported True whenever the budget is used up, whatever the certified error is.

mutants.name: m76_grid_whose_last_point_is_at_most_one_refused.py
mutants.description: a grid whose last point is at most one is refused, although the page names no such condition.

mutants.name: m77_stop_with_tolerance_inflated_by_a_millionth.py
mutants.description: the stop uses tol times (1 + 1e-9), so a certified error just above tol is accepted as converged.

mutants.name: m78_feasibility_with_tie_tolerance.py
mutants.description: the feasibility test allows successors up to 1e-9 above k**alpha, so a saving just above the resources is taken.

mutants.name: m79_relative_change_certificate.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (verifier-written, M5 slice d round 5): the change is relative, max|V_n - V_{n-1}| / max(1, |V_n|), so the certified error is too small when the values are large.

mutants.name: m80_stops_at_the_a_priori_count.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (verifier-written, M5 slice d round 5): the solver runs the a priori count of sweeps and stops there, without testing the certified error against tol at each sweep.

mutants.name: m81_first_grid_point_never_a_successor.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (verifier-written, M5 slice d round 5): the successor loop starts at the second grid point, so the first point is never a saving, and a state with no other feasible saving has no value.

mutants.name: m82_grid_allows_equal_points.py
mutants.description: the grid check accepts a repeated point: strict increase is tested with >= replaced by >.

mutants.name: m83_first_point_strictly_below_one.py
mutants.description: the first grid point is refused when it equals 1, although the specification allows it.

mutants.name: m84_alpha_accepts_one.py
mutants.description: alpha = 1 is accepted, although alpha must lie in the open interval (0, 1).

mutants.name: m85_tolerance_converted_with_float.py
mutants.description: tol is converted with float(), so a boolean or a numeric string is accepted.

mutants.name: m86_budget_accepts_float.py
mutants.description: max_iter is accepted as a float and truncated, so 2.0 and 1.0 are accepted as budgets.

mutants.name: m87_values_longer_than_grid_accepted.py
mutants.description: bellman_operator accepts a values list longer than the grid, and uses its first entries.

mutants.name: m88_certificate_factor_one_over_one_minus_beta.py
mutants.description: the certified error uses 1 / (1 - beta) in place of beta / (1 - beta), which is still a valid but looser bound.

mutants.name: m89_budget_loses_one_sweep.py
mutants.description: the loop makes one sweep fewer than max_iter when max_iter is above one.

mutants.name: m90_feasibility_strict_inequality.py
mutants.description: a saving exactly equal to k**alpha is refused, so feasibility is k' < k**alpha.

mutants.name: m91_in_place_sweep.py
mutants.description: the sweep updates the vector in place, so later states use the new values of earlier states.

mutants.name: m92_grid_rejected_when_any_point_exceeds_one.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (verifier-written, M5 slice d round 6): every grid point must be at most one, not only the first point.

mutants.name: m93_infeasible_successor_valued_by_sqrt_of_abs.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (verifier-written, M5 slice d round 6): the feasibility test is dropped and an infeasible successor is valued at sqrt of the absolute consumption.

mutants.name: m94_first_sweep_skips_the_stopping_test.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (verifier-written, M5 slice d round 6): the stopping test is only applied from the second sweep on, so a certified error equal to tol at sweep one does not stop it.

mutants.name: m95_stop_test_relative_to_the_largest_value.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (verifier-written, M5 slice d round 7): the stop test scales tol by the largest value, so a relative tolerance replaces the absolute one.

mutants.name: m96_alpha_hard_coded_to_one_half.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (verifier-written, M5 slice d round 7): the resources are k**0.5 whatever alpha is, so the exponent parameter is ignored in the feasibility test.

mutants.name: m97_change_skips_the_first_grid_point.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (verifier-written, M5 slice d round 7): the sweep change is the maximum over the grid points after the first, so the first point is left out of the certificate.

mutants.name: m98_utility_sqrt_of_consumption_plus_one.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (verifier-written, M5 slice d round 8): the utility is sqrt(c + 1) instead of sqrt(c), so the zero-consumption saving is valued at one.

mutants.name: m99_grid_sorted_before_the_order_check.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (verifier-written, M5 slice d round 8): the grid is sorted before the strictly-increasing check, so a decreasing grid is silently accepted.

mutants.name: r3_01_operator_clamps_each_image_at_zero.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d round 3): bellman_operator clamps each image value at zero, as if utilities made every value nonnegative, so it departs from the definition for any input vector with a negative entry.

mutants.name: r3_02_continuation_uses_absolute_value.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d round 3): the continuation term is beta times the absolute value of V(k'), so a negative continuation value is read as positive.

mutants.name: r3_03_feasibility_tie_tolerance_of_1e-14.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d round 3): feasibility allows a successor up to 1e-14 above k**alpha, a float-rounding tolerance that the exact test k' <= k**alpha does not have.

mutants.name: r4_01_change_is_the_euclidean_norm_of_the_difference.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d round 4): the change of a sweep is the Euclidean norm of the difference, not the largest absolute entry, so the certified error is computed from the wrong norm.

mutants.name: r4_02_certificate_factor_is_one_minus_beta_over_beta.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d round 4): the certified error uses (1 - beta) / beta in place of beta / (1 - beta), inverting the geometric-sum factor of the certified bound.

mutants.name: r4_03_continuation_reads_the_next_grid_value.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d round 4): the continuation term uses V at the grid point after the saving, an index off by one, instead of V(k') at the saving itself.

mutants.name: r4_04_utility_takes_the_root_of_the_output_only.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d round 4): the utility is the square root of the output alone minus the saving, a parenthesis error that writes sqrt(k**alpha) - k' in place of sqrt(k**alpha - k').

mutants.name: r5_01_resources_are_capital_below_one.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d round 5): output is taken to be the capital itself on the part of the grid in (0, 1], so the feasible savings use k instead of k**alpha there.

mutants.name: r5_02_value_is_the_bellman_image.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d round 5): solve returns the operator applied once more to the last iterate, not the iterate that the certified error refers to.

mutants.name: r5_03_utility_splits_the_root_of_the_difference.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d round 5): the utility is written as sqrt(k**alpha) - sqrt(k') instead of sqrt(k**alpha - k').

mutants.name: r6_01_stop_only_when_certified_error_strictly_below_tol.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d round 6): solve stops only when the certified error is strictly below tol, so a sweep whose certified error equals tol exactly is not accepted.

mutants.name: r6_02_saving_must_leave_strictly_positive_consumption.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d round 6): a saving equal to k**alpha, which leaves zero consumption, is treated as infeasible, so the feasible set is the strict inequality k' < k**alpha.

mutants.name: r6_03_solve_starts_from_the_ones_vector.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d round 6): solve starts value iteration from the vector of ones instead of the zero vector the page names as V_0.

mutants.name: v10_01_double_discount_in_the_continuation.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (verifier-written, M5 slice d round 10): the continuation is discounted twice, beta squared times V(k'), so the operator is not the Bellman operator of the page.

mutants.name: v10_02_tolerance_scaled_by_grid_size.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (verifier-written, M5 slice d round 10): the stop test compares the certified error with tol times the number of grid points, so a looser tolerance is accepted on larger grids.

mutants.name: v10_03_savings_capped_by_capital.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (verifier-written, M5 slice d round 10): a saving is feasible only if it is at most the current capital k as well as at most k**alpha, wrongly excluding savings above k when k is below one.

mutants.name: v11_01_utility_uses_capital_not_output.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d round 11): utility is sqrt(k - k') while feasibility still uses k**alpha, so the consumption in the utility ignores the production exponent.

mutants.name: v11_02_operator_returns_the_best_successor_not_the_value.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d round 11): the Bellman operator returns the optimal successor capital k' (the policy) at each grid point instead of the maximised value.

mutants.name: v11_03_converged_means_budget_not_exhausted.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d round 11): converged is read off the loop (iterations below the budget) instead of the certified error being within tol.

mutants.name: v12_01_stop_test_uses_beta_times_change.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d round 12): the stop test compares beta times the change with tol, dropping the 1/(1 - beta) factor of the certificate, so the solver stops before the certified error is within tol.

mutants.name: v12_02_continuation_read_in_reverse_order.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d round 12): the continuation values are read in reverse grid order, so each successor k' is paired with the value of the mirror-image grid point.

mutants.name: v12_03_value_returned_is_beta_times_the_iterate.py
mutants.description: Student-error mutant (M5 slice d round 12): solve returns beta times the iterate as value, confusing the value with its continuation term; the certified error still refers to the iterate.
